data.one_liner: Protocol specification for bundling data assets with Dart and Flutter packages using build hooks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a hook protocol specification to bundle data assets (as strings or bytes) with Dart and Flutter packages. It is designed to be used inside build hooks (`hook/build.dart`).
use_when: You are writing a build hook for a Dart or Flutter package that needs to bundle data assets.
You want to programmatically add data assets during the build process.
avoid_when: You need a stable production-ready package, as this is currently experimental with a high rate of breaking changes.
You are just bundling standard static assets via pubspec.yaml.
strengths: Enables programmatic bundling of data assets via build hooks.
Tracks generated data asset files for cache invalidation.
weaknesses: Experimental package under labs.dart.dev with a high expected rate of breaking changes and API evolution.
Limited documentation; requires familiarity with package:hooks.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up build hooks (`hook/build.dart`) and depending on `package:hooks`.
